records.title: The Impossible Sign
records.premise_pattern: A familiar {location} begins showing a {disruption} that should not be possible.
records.trigger_pattern: The anomaly becomes undeniable in front of people who cannot all dismiss it.
stakes_prompts: What changes if the anomaly spreads or becomes public?
escalation_prompts: A second manifestation contradicts the first explanation.
open_questions: Who benefits from treating the anomaly as ordinary?
What makes the sign personally relevant now?

records.title: The Reliable Thing Fails
records.premise_pattern: A dependable {resource} or system abruptly stops working at the worst plausible moment.
records.trigger_pattern: People discover that ordinary fallback options are also becoming unreliable.
stakes_prompts: Who loses safety, status or leverage if the failure continues?
escalation_prompts: The failure begins affecting a second linked resource.
open_questions: Is this sabotage, depletion, neglect or a larger change?
Who controls the remaining working alternative?

records.title: The Boundary Moved
records.premise_pattern: A trusted boundary around {location} no longer behaves as expected, changing who or what can cross it.
records.trigger_pattern: Someone crosses the altered boundary and proves the old assumptions obsolete.
stakes_prompts: What is now exposed, trapped, reachable or cut off?
escalation_prompts: The boundary shifts again while people are adapting.
open_questions: Was the old boundary natural, engineered, political or supernatural?
Who wants the new boundary to remain?

records.title: Everyone Remembers Differently
records.premise_pattern: Multiple people connected to {past_event} now remember incompatible versions of it.
records.trigger_pattern: A new {evidence} makes at least one confident account impossible to keep intact.
stakes_prompts: What relationships or decisions depend on one version being true?
escalation_prompts: A second contradiction implicates someone not previously involved.
open_questions: Are memories altered, mistaken, partitioned or strategically false?
What fact remains consistent across every account?

records.title: The Ritual Breaks
records.premise_pattern: A routine, ceremony or repeated process tied to {obligation} cannot be completed in its usual way.
records.trigger_pattern: The people responsible must proceed, postpone or improvise under observation.
stakes_prompts: What legitimacy, safety or trust depends on completion?
escalation_prompts: A rival interpretation of what should happen next gains support.
open_questions: Why did the normal method fail now?
Who is empowered by improvisation?

records.title: The Environment Turns
records.premise_pattern: A familiar {location} develops a new environmental behavior that threatens old routes and habits.
records.trigger_pattern: A previously safe path, shelter or resource becomes unreliable.
stakes_prompts: Who or what is stranded by the change?
escalation_prompts: The environmental shift reveals something previously inaccessible.
open_questions: Is the change temporary, cyclical or permanent?
Who adapts fastest and gains advantage?

records.title: The Rule Has an Exception
records.premise_pattern: A rule everyone relies on appears not to apply to one {target}.
records.trigger_pattern: An {authority_actor} or witness confirms the exception is real enough to matter.
stakes_prompts: What institutions or plans depend on the rule being universal?
escalation_prompts: Someone else claims or demonstrates the same exception.
open_questions: Why this target?
Is the rule wrong, incomplete, bypassed or changing?

records.title: The Message Network Goes Quiet
records.premise_pattern: A trusted means of communication involving {location} or {affected_actor} suddenly goes silent.
records.trigger_pattern: An incomplete or delayed {evidence} arrives through an unusual route.
stakes_prompts: What decision must be made before normal communication returns?
escalation_prompts: A conflicting message arrives claiming to explain the silence.
open_questions: Who can still communicate and why?
What information is dangerous to assume?

records.title: The Wrong Identity Fits
records.premise_pattern: A person or object tied to {target} carries convincing signs of an identity that should belong elsewhere.
records.trigger_pattern: Someone with standing treats the mismatch as legitimate.
stakes_prompts: What rights, duties or dangers follow from accepting either identity?
escalation_prompts: Another claimant appears with equally credible evidence.
open_questions: Which parts of identity are verifiable?
Who needs the ambiguity resolved quickly?

records.title: The Small Change Spreads
records.premise_pattern: A minor {disruption} first noticed in one corner of {location} begins repeating elsewhere.
records.trigger_pattern: The pattern reaches something important enough that ignoring it is no longer easy.
stakes_prompts: What happens if the pattern reaches a critical place or person?
escalation_prompts: The spread skips an expected target and appears somewhere more consequential.
open_questions: What links affected sites?
What remains untouched and why?
